description: Static emitted arithmetic counts. Conventional FMA=2; weighted FMA=1. Distance geometry is evaluated inside direct kernels and excluded from DAG counts.

spherical.description: Exact live emitted arithmetic per lane, including geometry and output accumulation. Unary signs, copies, comparisons and selects cost zero. Division by square root costs eight. These weighted costs are not measured timings.

basisConversion.description: Exact sparse basis maps; overwrite outputs at the same center and units. No coordinate, potential or background scaling. Source dipoles always retained.

cartesianTracefree.description: Static emitted arithmetic counts. Conventional FMA=2; weighted FMA=1. Distance geometry is evaluated inside direct kernels and excluded from DAG counts.

m2l_comparison.description: Free-space M2L, including displacement geometry and additive output; source degree = FMM order - 2, local degree = FMM order - 1. Generic source dipoles are retained. Application coordinate-unit conversion is excluded from both families. +, -, *, / and explicit FMA cost 1; sqrt costs 7. Both families emit explicit FMAs; no additional compiler contraction is assumed. These are emitted arithmetic counts, not measured instruction counts or timings.
